items.name: Crow Jerky
items.description: Strips of dried crow meat. It tastes exactly as you would expect. It sustains you regardless.

items.name: stone inscription
items.description: A heavy inscribed fragment. Broken from something larger.

items.name: water skin
items.drink_message: Cold and flat. The thirst retreats.
items.description: A leather skin, filled with water. The hide is old but the stitching holds. Something alive is in it still.

items.name: bitter herb
items.eat_message: Bitter. Something in it is faintly wrong. The hunger retreats slightly.
items.description: A dried sprig of something that grows near water and stone. Hedge practitioners harvest it. It is edible in the way that most things are edible — with consequences.

items.name: empty water skin
items.description: A leather skin, empty. The seams are still sound. Could be refilled from clean water.
